findings.title: Use the account UI interpolation format instead of Java MessageFormat
findings.body: This bundle uses the account UI's `{{0}}` interpolation syntax (as do the surrounding validation messages), but this change replaces it with Java `MessageFormat` syntax including a `choice` expression. The frontend translator will not substitute `{0}`, `{1}`, or evaluate `{2,choice,...}`, so this validation error is rendered with raw placeholders/pattern text. Keep the existing UI interpolation syntax and implement pluralization using the frontend i18n mechanism if needed.

findings.title: Use the admin UI interpolation format instead of Java MessageFormat
findings.body: The admin UI resource previously used `{{0}}`/`{{1}}`/`{{2}}`, which is the frontend message interpolation contract. Replacing it with Java `MessageFormat` and `choice` syntax leaves the parameters and choice expression uninterpreted by the admin UI, causing the multivalued-attribute validation message to display raw formatting tokens.

findings.title: Safe HTML is rejected when the sanitizer merely canonicalizes it
findings.body:
The verifier treats any byte-for-byte difference between the input and sanitizer output as illegal HTML. The OWASP sanitizer canonicalizes valid allowed markup, for example `
` to `
`, even though no unsafe content was removed. The many unrelated `
` to `
` edits in this PR are evidence of this behavior. Future translations containing valid equivalent HTML will fail verification and be reported as unsafe; validation should distinguish removal of disallowed content from harmless serialization normalization, with positive tests for accepted safe variants.

findings.title: Lithuanian account TOTP instruction was replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `messages_lt.properties` is the Lithuanian account bundle, but `totpStep1` now says `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, which is Italian. Lithuanian users will see an untranslated/wrong-language setup instruction; replace it with Lithuanian text.

findings.title: Lithuanian login TOTP instruction was replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `messages_lt.properties` is the Lithuanian login bundle, but `loginTotpStep1` now contains the Italian sentence `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`. This makes the login-time TOTP setup instruction appear in the wrong language for Lithuanian users.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese bundle now contains a Traditional Chinese TOTP instruction
findings.body: The `zh_CN` bundle otherwise uses Simplified Chinese, but the new `totpStep1` text uses Traditional Chinese characters such as `手機` and `應用程式`. This creates an inconsistent wrong-script message for the Simplified Chinese locale; use a Simplified Chinese translation.
